result.markdown:
# Transport degradation on LNK-TUN-02-A affecting S-TUN-009

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_degradation at `LNK-TUN-02-A`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct alarm evidence on the shared microwave link matches the exact timing of KPI deviations, and maintenance/changes were checked and ruled out.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-20 04:30 to 2026-09-20 06:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-20 04:27
- **Affected:** S-TUN-009, S-TUN-004, S-TUN-015

## Summary

Microwave link degradation on LNK-TUN-02-A caused latency increase and traffic impact on S-TUN-009 and peer sites.

Latency increased and traffic dropped at S-TUN-009 and sibling sites between 2026-09-20 04:30 and 2026-09-20 06:00.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-20 04:27: Major alarm LINK_DEGRADED raised on microwave link LNK-TUN-02-A [ALM-000414]
- 2026-09-20 04:30: Latency spike and volume deviation detected across affected sites [T3, T7, ALR-0030, ANM-000234]
- 2026-09-20 06:00: Impact recovery observed as latency and volume returned to baseline [T3, T7]
- 2026-09-20 06:12: LINK_DEGRADED alarm cleared on LNK-TUN-02-A [ALM-000414]

## Evidence

- S-TUN-009 experienced a latency spike and anomaly starting at 2026-09-20 04:30. [T1, T3, ANM-000234]
- S-TUN-009, S-TUN-004, and S-TUN-015 all share the microwave link LNK-TUN-02-A and aggregation router AGG-TUN-02. [T2]
- Major alarm LINK_DEGRADED occurred on LNK-TUN-02-A starting at 2026-09-20 04:27 and cleared at 2026-09-20 06:12. [T4, ALM-000414]
- Sibling sites S-TUN-004 and S-TUN-015 also showed latency deviations starting at 2026-09-20 04:30. [T7]
- No maintenance windows or configuration changes were scheduled or performed on S-TUN-009 or its parents during the incident window. [T5, T6]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_degradation** at LNK-TUN-02-A: confirmed. Directly supported by the major LINK_DEGRADED alarm on the shared link matching the onset and duration of the site latency spikes. [T2, T4, ALM-000414]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-009: rejected. No changes were recorded on S-TUN-009 or its parent nodes during the relevant time window. [T6]
3. **planned_maintenance** at S-TUN-009: rejected. No maintenance was scheduled on S-TUN-009 or its parent nodes during the relevant time window. [T5]

## Ruled out

- EVT-002: Stadium event occurred earlier in the evening (18:12 to 22:02 on 2026-09-19) near S-TUN-001 and is unrelated to the 04:30 latency spike.
- ALM-000410: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-TUN-015 cleared hours before the incident window started.
- ALM-000411: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-TUN-015 cleared hours before the incident window started.
- ALM-000412: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-TUN-015 cleared hours before the incident window started.
- ALM-000413: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-TUN-015 cleared hours before the incident window started.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect microwave link LNK-TUN-02-A radio hardware and path fading telemetry to determine the root cause of the degradation.
